svg.aria-label: Deckhand opening picture r5: the Deckhand bollard icon and wordmark with the AceEngineer wordmark; a Deckhand icon holds the rope, which steps up from the n-1 model with a simple formula (hoop stress) to the n+1 model with a complex formula (von Mises stress); labelled as an illustration; the title The model we use matters
